Name: Tundra
Details: The Tundra biome is a cold boreal forest, with icy peaks and barren permafrost. Heat sinks slightly more readily in this biome, but occasional pockets of geothermally heated hot springs can reduce heat efficiency for any 'Mech that stands in them. Weather Conditions: • Gravity: +/-15% efficacy of Jump Jets and DFA damage • Dawn/Dusk: +1 To Hit with all weapons, negative removed if target is above 75 heat • Night: +2 To Hit with all weapons, -1 to hit per 60 heat of the target, 10% movement speed reduction • Foggy: 10% movement speed reduction
